title: Learned smoothing in operator-adapted multigrid: controlled accuracy gains and computational limits
summary: Learned multigrid components are often evaluated at a fixed iteration budget, but such comparisons do not distinguish local approximation gains from practical solver efficiency. We study this distinction for high-contrast elliptic problems on unstructured finite element meshes. A learned V-cycle uses operator-dependent transfers, Galerkin coarse operators, near-kernel deflation and an energy-norm safeguard; only its smoothers are trained.
